intro.title: Laundry & dry cleaning price list in Gurgaon & Delhi NCR
intro.body: Looking for affordable laundry and dry cleaning prices in Gurgaon? Premium garment care shouldn't cost a fortune. Whether you need wash & fold for everyday clothes, premium dry cleaning for a wedding lehenga, or steam ironing for office wear, the rates below are the rates you pay — with free pickup and delivery across Gurgaon & NCR.

difference._note: Adapted from the SEO guide's comparison table. The named-competitor version (DhobiLite, Tumbledry, local dhobi rates) is deliberately NOT published — those are third-party prices we cannot verify and naming them invites a complaint. The same points are made about our own pricing instead.

faqs.a: No — every price on this page is a base rate and GST is added at 18% as per government norms. It is shown separately in your cart, so there are no surprises at the end.

faqs.q: Why is dry cleaning priced per item but laundry priced per kilo?
faqs.a: Laundry is bulk work, so weighing by the kilo is fairer for a family load. Dry cleaning needs individual inspection, stain treatment and handling per garment, so per-item pricing means you only pay for the pieces that need expert care.

faqs.q: How much does dry cleaning a lehenga or wedding outfit cost?
faqs.a: Our lehenga rate starts at ₹399. Heavy, bridal and beadwork pieces are quoted after inspection, because the price depends on weight, embroidery and fabric. Send a photo on WhatsApp and we will give you an accurate figure before you commit.
We own our processing facility rather than running as a franchise, and our machinery is water- and power-efficient, so our rates sit below most app-based services while pickup and delivery stay free.

faqs.q: Do you offer corporate or bulk pricing?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide customised commercial rates for hotels, salons, gyms, corporate offices and housing societies. Email care@wash4you.in or call us for a tailored quote.

faqs.q: Can I get same-day or express service?
faqs.a: Express processing is available at 1.5× the standard rate. Same-day delivery depends on your area and the size of the order — call to confirm availability before you book.

faqs.q: What if I am not happy with the result?
faqs.a: Tell us and we will reprocess the order at no additional cost. We would rather redo a piece than have you live with it.
